newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds end little changed.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds end little changed.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices started the week little changed with the stronger dollar countering new contact lows at the close of the Chicago soy futures on Friday.
"People appear to waiting for the market to bottom out, but there is little sign of that happening yet," said one.
High protein sellers were mostly unchanged while rape meal was down two stg for Aug/Oct material from the Liverpool and Hull mills. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
